messages:
incident-bot: INC001234: Elevated 5xx rate detected in region eu-west-1 — automatic paging triggered to on-call group. Severity: P1.
oncall-alex: I’m on it, seeing alerts + dashboards. 5xx spike started ~8:12 UTC and correlates with a big increase in avg backend latency.
samira: I can look at gateway logs and routing metrics. Is there a specific model pool impacted?
oncall-alex: Initial filter shows gateway-proxy pool eu-west-1a has 5xx and timeout errors, only when routed through route-v2. Other pools less affected.
ops-liz: Support reporting customers A and C seeing repeated 502s when calling generation endpoints. Nina, can you surface customer impact?
support-nina: Customer A (account-a) report: ~15% of requests failing with 502 in last 10m. They have some batch jobs running but also interactive traffic. Customer C sees timeouts. Escalated to SE.
infra-jay: Looking at infra graphs — host socket queues in eu-west-1b spiked, but CPU/GPU look normal. Connection resets + some upstream service 524s. Could be a proxy/backpressure issue.
oncall-alex: Good catch. Samira, can you grep proxy logs for connection reset/503s and paste a few snippets?
samira: Pasted sample from gateway-proxy-7: ```
[2026-03-05T08:13:21Z] conn_reset remote=10.4.23.11:34512 dst=10.2.11.5:443 route=route-v2 status=502
[2026-03-05T08:13:22Z] upstream_timeout service=embed-cacher timeout_ms=12000 route=route-v2
```
ops-liz: That embed-cacher upstream timeout aligns with KV cache saturation during a prefix-heavy workload. Could cause cascading 502/524.
oncall-alex: For immediate mitigation: plan A) reroute some traffic off route-v2 to route-v1 in eu-west-1, plan B) shift a % of traffic to eu-central-1 as cross-region fallback. Which is faster?
infra-jay: We can change route weights via traffic manager. Quick patch: set route-v2 weight -> 30%, route-v1 -> 70% for eu-west-1. Then enable cross-region steer to eu-central-1 at 10% for non-interactive tenants.
oncall-alex: Do it. Samira, please apply the weight change and verify logs. Liz, coordinate support message to affected customers.
samira: Applying weight change now: ```
# trafficctl set-weight --region eu-west-1 --route route-v2=30 --route route-v1=70
OK: weights applied
```
samira: Seeing 5xx start to trend down in the last 60s on route-v2, overall errors decrease ~40%.
support-nina: Messaging sent to Customer A/C: "We're investigating increased errors in EU region; we've applied routing changes to reduce impact and will follow up." :thumbsup:
oncall-alex: Good. Deploy-bot, any recent deploys to gateway or embed-cacher around ~08:10?
deploy-bot: Recent deploys: embed-cacher v3.14.2 rolled 07:55 UTC to eu-west, gateway-proxy v2.9.0 rolled 05:20 UTC (no rollouts at 08:10). No current canary failures flagged automatically.
infra-jay: Since embed-cacher got a change earlier, it could be a config/pathological batch causing cache misses & upstream pressure. I can scale embed-cacher replicas in eu-west-1 by +30% as a stop-gap.
ops-liz: Alex, agree to scale and add circuit breaker on route-v2 to limit concurrent upstream connections to embed-cacher from gateway?
oncall-alex: Yes, do both. Samira, hit scale and apply circuit breaker. Use conservative limits.
samira: Scaling embed-cacher: ```
# k scale deployment embed-cacher -n inference eu-west-1 --replicas +30%
Scaling initiated, new replica target 26 -> observed 34
```
samira: Applying circuit breaker rule: ```
# trafficctl set-circuit --route route-v2 --upstream embed-cacher max_conns=1200 max_pending=200
OK
```
samira: After those changes error rate dropped further, now ~2% above baseline. Latency back to normal for most requests.
oncall-alex: Excellent. I'll keep the incident open for monitoring for 30m and then start a gradual rollback of emergency changes if stable. Liz, update customers with ETA.
support-nina: Updated Customer A: "We see errors falling after routing+scaling changes; continuing to monitor and will follow up with root cause and timeline"
ops-liz: We should also flag this for an RCA focused on embed-cacher's behavior under prefix-heavy workloads + cache miss storms. Assigning to Samira + Infra Jay.
infra-jay: Will collect heap profiles, socket stats, and request traces from embed-cacher and gateway-proxy. Also look into whether a specific batch job from Customer A triggered heavy cold misses.
oncall-alex: Handoff to next on-call in 30m: @oncall-maya — I'll post a summary and actions. If errors spike above 4% again, re-escalate.
oncall-alex: Summary: 5xx/timeouts in eu-west-1 due to embed-cacher upstream timeouts and proxy resets. Mitigations: route weight shift, cross-region 10% steer, scaled embed-cacher + circuit breaker, customer comms. Responsible: Samira, Infra Jay, Ops Liz. Post-incident RCA assigned.
oncall-alex: Closing active mitigation window, leaving monitoring to next on-call. If stable for 30m, we will revert temporary weights/circuit limits back to normal with a controlled rollout. :white_check_mark:
oncall-alex: incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, error rate decreasing. Monitoring continues.
oncall-alex: End of thread.
